title: The localizing right adjoint preserves bounded constructibility
statement:
Fix a universe u, a prime $\ell$, and a field $k$ in universe u of positive
characteristic different from $\ell$. Let $Z,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes
and let $g:Z\to Y$ be a proper $k$-morphism [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $\Lambda$ be
a commutative condensed ring with its specified multiplication and a certificate
of one of the three adic coefficient families [def-sfb-adic-coefficient-certificate].
For $T=Z,Y$, put $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$, let $D_T=D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_T})$
be the ordinary unbounded module-object derived category
[sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], let $\mathcal B_T$ be its bounded constructible
full subcategory [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible], and let
$\mathcal L_T=\operatorname{Loc}(\mathcal B_T)$ be the full localizing hull, using
ambient coproducts indexed in universe u+1
[def-sfb-bounded-constructible-localizing-closure].
Let $F_g:\mathcal L_Z\to\mathcal L_Y$ be the canonical restriction of the ambient
$Rg_*$ [lem-sfb-adic-proper-localizing-pushforward]. For every functor
$G:\mathcal L_Y\to\mathcal L_Z$ and every adjunction $F_g\dashv G$, and for every
$K\in\mathcal B_Y$, the underlying ambient object of G(K) belongs to $\mathcal B_Z$.
The inclusion of $\mathcal B_Y$ into $\mathcal L_Y$ is the canonical full inclusion.
The assertion concerns any supplied right adjoint and does not select arbitrary data.

proof.text: First make the Noetherian coefficient comparison between the local finite-presentation predicate in Lean and the source adic local models. Use the field and Qlbar local-freeness theorems, and in the integral case the local torsion charts and locally free resolution. This avoids assuming arbitrary presentation matrices have constant entries.

For the E and finite-subextension Qlbar coefficient cases, specialize the rational restriction theorem to g and the identity compactification. Its smooth-projection calculation uses the diagonal class and the P1 trace; the closed-immersion calculation uses the localization triangle and constructibility of the complementary open direct image. Closed/smooth local factorizations and open descent give bounded constructibility.

For OE use the integral restriction theorem. The torsion-level smooth and closed calculations are compatible with the transition maps, and their adic limit gives the integral restriction. Equality Dctf=Dbc identifies the resulting preservation condition with the object property in Lean.

Both geometric constructions are right adjoint to the same proper localizing pushforward, because its identity compactification has identity extension by zero. Uniqueness of right adjoints identifies their value at K with G(K). The bounded-constructible property is invariant under isomorphism, giving the stated conclusion.

      (boundedConstructibleLocalizingClosure Λ Z.left).FullSubcategory)
